import os, tempfile
from miniconf.loader import load
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    def w(n, t):
        p=os.path.join(d,n); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True); open(p,'w').write(t)
    w('a.conf','@include b.conf\n'); w('b.conf','x=1\n@include a.conf\n')
    w('m.conf','k=1\n@include sub/n.conf\nk2=late\n')
    w('sub/n.conf','k=2\nk2=inc\n@include n2.conf\n'); w('sub/n2.conf','deep=yes\n')
    w('miss.conf','@include nope.conf\n'); w('self.conf','@include self.conf\n')
    c=load(os.path.join(d,'m.conf')); print(c.get('k'),c.get('k2'),c.get('deep'))
    for f in ['a','miss','self']:
        try: load(os.path.join(d,f+'.conf'))

EOF
